'''Bazel Warv''', nicknamed '''Barv''', was a [[Ramoan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ramoa]], and a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] in the [[New Jedi Order]]. He was [[The Unit|good friends]] with fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]], [[Valin Horn]], and Valin's sister [[Jysella Horn|Jysella]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], after both Horn siblings developed a [[Force psychosis|psychosis]], he and Saav'etu also developed the mysterious affliction. After being captured by the Jedi, he and Saav'etu, along with two other psychotic Knights, [[Seff Hellin]] and [[Natua Wan]], were smuggled off [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to [[Shedu Maad]] to escape their capture by [[Galactic Alliance Security]].

He was killed defending the young [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]] during an ambush by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Lost Tribe]] dragging a Sith into the cannons of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].

==Biography==
During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] Bazel Warv as a youngling was kept at [[Shelter]], along with many other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] he was [[The Unit|close friends]] with fellow Jedi [[Valin Horn]], [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]], and [[Jysella Horn]]. After Valin's descent into [[Force psychosis|madness]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], he comforted Jysella on the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|steps]] of the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] and was one of the last people to see her before she also went insane.<ref name="Omen" />

While at a tapcaf across from the Jedi Temple, Saav'etu and Warv witnessed Jysella Horn [[Telekinesis/Legends|tossing]] civilians across the [[Processional Way/Legends|Processional Way]]. Rushing out to stop her, the two Jedi were [[Skirmish on the Processional Way|attacked]] by Horn, who used [[flow-walking]] to predict their movements. After slashing Warv in the chest, Horn escaped, only to be captured by [[Galactic Alliance Security]] forces shortly after. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Cilghal and several other Jedi rushed onto the scene, escorting Saav'etu and helping Warv back to the Temple for healing and debriefing.<ref name="Omen" /> Sometime later, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] attempted to have Warv escort [[Solo family/Legends|her family]] during the [[Coruscant Livestock Exchange and Exhibition]]. However, this proved impossible, as he was offworld at the time.<ref name="Omen" /> After returning to Coruscant, Warv looked after Solo's adopted daughter [[Allana Djo Solo|Amelia]] while [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] visited the [[Jedi Temple detention center]].<ref name="Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>

Later, while strolling through the [[Fellowship Plaza]] on their way to the Jedi Temple, Warv and Saav'etu saw a camp of Security troopers and news reporters on the steps of the Temple. Not wanting to draw attention to themselves, the two Jedi headed for the private [[Jedi Temple/Legends|speeder entrance]] on the south side of the Temple. There, Warv realized that his [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] companion had succumbed to the same illness that the Horns had, and attempted to get her inside to the Asylum Block. However, the presence of [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] and Jaina Solo slowed their process. Eventually, the Ramoan too contracted the strange psychosis, and he and Saav'etu were incapacitated with the help of Han and Leia Solo, with Warv landing atop Fel's [[Limousine/Legends|limousine]] after being knocked out. As the Jedi hid Warv and Saav'etu in the Temple, a Galactic Alliance Security force arrived. Fel and Jaina managed to use Fel's diplomatic immunity to flee the scene, and as Jaina's parents went back inside the Temple and closed the gate behind them to buy some time. At some point Warv was injected with a sedative that caused a near fatal reaction.<ref name="Abyss" />

Soon after, Warv and Saav'etu, along with two other psychotic Jedi Knights, [[Seff Hellin]] and [[Natua Wan]], were evacuated out of the Jedi Temple. The group escorting them, including Han Solo, Leia Solo, and Jedi Knights [[Jaden Korr]] and [[Avinoam Arelis]], was [[Skirmish at the Krabbis Inn|attacked]] by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian Supercommando|Supercommandos]]. With the help of Warv, who demonstrated the ability to [[phase]], they defeated the assailants. Warv still did not want to cooperate with the Jedi, but [[Raynar Thul]] was able to convince him to get into the [[FloatVan]] that took the psychotic Knights to safety. Thul pulled this off by promising that Saav'etu would not be harmed if Warv cooperated, Warv's steadfast loyalty did not permit him to abandon his friend. Later, the four psychotic Jedi were smuggled off of Coruscant to escape prosecution by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. They were taken to [[Shedu Maad]] in the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]], where they would be out of reach of the Galactic Alliance.<ref name="Abyss" />

Warv was later killed while protecting Allana, sacrificing himself by dragging a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] into the repeating fire of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]{{'s}} quadlasers. By then he only had one arm and had so many [[Lightsaber/Legends|Lightsaber]] burns he was almost unrecognizable. He took at least 7 [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] with him when he died.<ref name="Apocalypse" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the preview of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'' included in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]'', Warv was identified as a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]]. This was changed for ''Omen'', however, in which he is identified as a Ramoan.
